title: DSWD to suspend AICS guarantee letters; cash aid continues

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will temporarily stop issuing guarantee letters (GLs) under its Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program starting Nov. 30, but will continue accepting people seeking outright cash assistance through its offices nationwide. DSWD spokesperson Assistant Secretary Irene Dumlao said on Monday, Nov. 23, that the suspension would allow the agency to complete its annual liquidation process and settle its financial obligations to service providers before the end of the year. “Atin po munang pansamantalang ititigil ang pag-issue ng guarantee letters sa ating AICS upang mabigyan ng panahon […]...
